causalBoundary: Exact trigger signature and slot, inclusive; later transactions are excluded even when local arrival_ms equals decisionUnixMs.

features.definition: Cumulative external gross buys minus external gross sells through the crossing transaction.
Mean external buy size in the later causal half divided by the earlier causal half.
Crossing/last external buy size divided by the median of prior causal external buys.
Cumulative external gross buy SOL through the crossing divided by successful transaction count.
features.conditionalExclusion: Exclude before fitting when absolute Spearman correlation with net_external_flow_sol is >=0.75.
